Their material inputs, rather than the medium numbers, distinguish them. Keep the top-layer components out of each bottom preparation and retain batch inputs without a guessed final concentration.

JCM629 explicitly reuses Medium628 with artificial saltwater replacing Modified Wolfe mineral solution. Both therefore contain the FeS preparation and agarose; the demonstrated distinguishing input is mineral solution versus artificial saltwater. Preserve receiving-layer and top-layer boundaries, processing and exact occurrence routing; neither bottom layer is neat FeS or a zero-valent iron preparation.
